Noor A. (People Ops): Quick thread for Kate B.'s hybrid onsite in Portland next Mon 12/07. She flies in from Vancouver, lands 08:15 PST. Requests: later start (10:30), quiet room after interview, lactation room access, parking, and clear expense steps for CAD receipts.
Liam K. (Recruiter): Kate prefers 10:30:30 PT window. She's vegan, no allergies. I'm confirming license plate for parking permit now.
Jules M. (Office Admin): I can hold Conf East + Quiet Pod. Need plate to book visitor spot. I can prep lactation room key and a vegan lunch.
Noor A. (People Ops): Expense note: original receipts preferred; photos OK. For CAD->USD include conversion note e.g., "200 CAD = $146.50 USD at xe.com on 2026-12-06". Taxi cap SFO->office is $85 (for US), BC candidates cap is CA$120. Send scans to travel@redwood.example within 30 days.
Liam K. (Recruiter): Kate says she'll take transit. Plate TBA. I'll send her the itinerary + Google Meet fallback 24h prior and CC travel@redwood.example.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Hybrid Onsite  Kate B." Mon Dec 7 10:30:30 PT  https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=plmno (rooms: Conf East + Quiet Pod, Meet fallback https://meet.google.com/xyz-123).
Jules M. (Office Admin): Quiet Pod set with lower desk and extra charger. Vegan boxed lunch ordered for 12:00. Badge ready under "Kate B."
Liam K. (Recruiter): I'll update if plate/ETA changes. Sending candidate expense template now. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Noor A. (People Ops): Marking this as the canonical day-of thread. Ping here for last-minute changes. :spiral_calendar:
